name: @volter/tunnel
description: WebSocket HTTP/WS reverse tunnel client — embeddable library (createTunnel) + CLI + a typed relay SDK (VolterClient).

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@volter/tunnel-core' build && bunx tsup client/tunnel-client.ts client/cli.ts --format esm --clean --out-dir dist && bun run --filter '@volter/tunnel-mcp' build
scripts.prepublishOnly: bunx tsup client/tunnel-client.ts client/cli.ts --format esm --clean --out-dir dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test ./test && (cd packages/core && bun test) && (cd packages/mcp && bun test)
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:cf
scripts.lint: biome check client packages server-cf/src examples
scripts.format: biome format --write client packages server-cf/src examples
